SELECT 
  fished_date_doy as day,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
  index_id,
  value,
  avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 6
ORDER BY index_id, avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 20;
